Decision 6 now holds the Linear-only skill ids (create-linear-ticket, execute-linear-ticket, linear-tracker-adapter) as a trusted constant in scripts/qualify-linear.py, kept the way TRUSTED_CONTRACT_SHA256 is and never derived from the candidate's catalog or profiles. Every file of those skills must be in the delta. The V26-3097 row moves a skill with the catalog and profiles changed together, so the registry stays valid, and asserts the qualifier fails naming the missing skill. The expected set no longer comes from the catalog the move edits, so the mutation where the check agrees with itself is caught.

Adopted as written. Decision 2 maps an authentication error to 401 and a forbidden error to 403, and leaves classify() unchanged. A rate limit or an authentication error is transient, as for Jira. A forbidden error goes through site_refuses(): permanent for that ticket, transient when the whole site refuses too. Every other error is a permanent 'failed'. The decision now agrees with the unchanged TRANSIENT tuple, so a row written to the decision passes without editing Jira's classification.

Adopted as written. Decision 8's row uses a record with an entry at journalThrough and one at journalThrough + 1. The first is a final skip with no comment. The second is posted once through the shipped tracker_linear.py, with its comment and marker on the stub. A mutation that skips everything fails that row, and so does an off-by-one at the boundary.
